profiles.instructions: For unfamiliar or long text files, begin with a small line range (at most 40 lines) using read offset and limit; use the resulting line clues to read only the needed ranges. Use only the declared tools and the task workspace. Preserve unchanged inputs and module export contracts.
profiles.hypothesis: Bounded initial reads may avoid the observed capacity stops without losing needed evidence; benefit and regressions must be measured.
Carrying bounded verbatim user/tool observations through native compaction may preserve facts that an evidence-only index discards. This is extractive retention, not a semantic summarizer.

metadata.randomness: temperature fixed, provider seed unavailable; server weights not frozen

cautions: Small fixed-suite sample; Wilson intervals describe observed repeated trials, not broad model capability. Repeats are not fully independent.
Memory-dependent tasks intentionally require extra private information; report separately.
Prices are pinned SDK catalog estimates, not account charges; cache and time-of-day affect billing.
Request counts are host model dispatches, not guaranteed HTTP attempt counts.
No automatic retry of failed trials, no model self-grading, no rule promotion from unverified diagnoses.
Order is seeded and interleaved; API caching, server model updates and network variance are not fully controlled.
